SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER
You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer's auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer's repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics
- Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer's engineering org
- Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage
- Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs
- Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer's auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever
- Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption
- Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
- Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
- 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science
- You've owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system
- You've built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production (using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript), and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path)
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
- 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders
- Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo
- Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
- Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the Australia or Singapore or Japan office
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:
The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.
Annual Salary:
$235,000 - $320,000 USD
Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

DATA ENGINEER, MARKETING
The Data team at SpaceXSI is a small team that works across the company to inform business and product decisions, and we're hiring the first member of our team to focus fully on marketing. Performance Marketing at SpaceXSI drives scaled acquisition across 10+ channels for Grok, Grok Bot, and our full portfolio of AI products, across consumer, SMB, startup, and enterprise audiences.
This role will sit in the central Data team and partner directly with Marketing leadership to own the measurement and analysis of performance marketing, growth marketing programs, and overall marketing measurement. You'll use your expertise to inform where the next dollar goes as we scale paid acquisition, while building the foundations of a world class marketing data team. Your job is to help us understand the impact of our activities and what we should do next.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Build and own the measurement layer for performance marketing: economics and performance by channel, campaign, audience, geo, and creative, across both PLG and Sales-Led revenue lines
- Design incrementality tests (geo, audience, and conversion lift) with channel owners, and use the results to move budget and calibrate attribution, not just to fill a slide
- Stand up and maintain our media-mix model, and pair it with test results to answer the big allocation questions: which channels to scale, which to cut, and where we're hitting saturation
- Own the quality of the predictive LTV signal we send to Meta, Google, and the other networks: validate it against realized revenue, catch drift and breakage early, and partner with Data and Engineering to improve it
- Keep pipeline source and campaign attribution separate and clean, so self-reported source, promo codes, click-based attribution, and CRM pipeline each answer their own question without double counting revenue
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
- 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, or data science supporting paid acquisition
- Strong SQL and Python skills
- Experience building data pipelines and predictive models, such as LTV or conversion-value models
- Familiarity with incrementality or holdout tests
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
- Experience building and running media-mix models and multi-touch or click-based attribution in production, and a clear view of where each one falls short
- Deep familiarity with how ad platforms (Meta, Google, and others) report, optimize, and ingest conversion signals, and a healthy skepticism of platform-reported numbers
- Experience at a company with significant paid marketing spend, ideally during a period of rapid growth
- Experience measuring both self-serve (PLG) and sales-led funnels
- Clear communication with non-technical partners and honesty about what the data does and doesn't support
- Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end as a first or early hire

You'll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI. Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development: Roll out SpaceXSI across strategic engineering organizations; configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions; help developers integrate SpaceXSI into real production workflows, not isolated demos; drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams; identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly

- Become a Trusted Technical Partner: Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders; lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions; advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy; coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress; help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves
- Drive Real Customer Outcomes: Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact; connect SpaceXSI usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality; help customers communicate the value of SpaceXSI internally and build momentum for broader adoption; turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization
- Help Make SpaceXSI Indispensable: Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness; monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on SpaceXSI over time; support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction; help customers build workflows they can't imagine operating without
- Shape the Future of the Product: Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering; identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements; help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships; turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns

- A strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
- Strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
- High ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity
- A passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering

SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER, PRETRAINING DATA
We're looking for Senior Software Engineers to build and own the data systems behind our frontier models' initial training. You'll work on large-scale crawling, data platform, and pipeline infrastructure, turning raw dumps into the datasets our models train on, and making iteration with researchers fast and reliable. As a senior engineer, you'll set technical direction for these systems, lead projects across teams, and mentor other engineers as our pretraining data scales.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Data Platform: Design, build, and scale the distributed infrastructure that transforms raw web, code, multimodal, and acquired data into training-ready datasets for frontier model pretraining. Own high-throughput data pipelines, orchestration systems, and tooling that enable fast, reliable, observable, and reproducible data processing at massive scale, with end-to-end visibility into data lineage, freshness, and pipeline health.
- Data Quality: Build and deploy high-performance models and algorithms to classify, rank, deduplicate, filter, and clean training data at extreme throughput. Design and execute rigorous experiments across data mixtures, sampling strategies, and quality thresholds to quantify their impact on training loss, downstream evaluations, and model capabilities, translating research findings into production systems.
- Crawling: Build and optimize large-scale web crawling infrastructure spanning URL discovery, prioritization, host scheduling, fetching, parsing, and content extraction. Improve crawl coverage, efficiency, and reliability through intelligent scheduling, anti-bot resilience, robust extraction systems, and automated recovery, ensuring high-quality web data flows seamlessly into downstream training pipelines.
- Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Lead complex engineering initiatives across Data Platform, Data Quality, Crawling, Acquisition, and model training teams. Influence technical direction, drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and translate improvements in data infrastructure, coverage, and quality into measurable gains in model performance.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building distributed systems and/or large-scale data infrastructure
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
- Strong infrastructure or data platform background, ideally with a spike of outlier depth
- High-slope engineer who has moved unusually fast (e.g., staff-level ownership within a few years) or brings relevant domain experience
- Able to architect and ship end-to-end with high ownership, debug complex systems independently, and work alongside AI agents
- Strong intuitions about large-scale distributed systems, including running them reliably at frontier scale
- Track record of leading technical projects across teams and mentoring other engineers
- Excited to learn how pre-training data shapes model quality, and want the ownership and visibility that comes with building systems that feed frontier training runs

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Data Platform:
- Build the platform that turns raw web, code, multimodal, and acquired data into training-ready datasets for frontier pretraining runs
- Own the pipelines, orchestration, and tooling that make pretraining data iteration fast, reliable, observable, and reproducible at scale
- Create clear signals for data quality, lineage, freshness, and pipeline health so researchers can trust what goes into each run

Data Quality:
- Build and own high-throughput, fully telemetered data pipelines that process frontier-scale data with end-to-end traceability. If something breaks or drifts, your systems will tell us before the training run does
- Train and ship models that classify, rank, filter, clean, and identify data at extreme throughput. These models have to be both accurate and fast enough to sit in the critical path without becoming the bottleneck

- Partner tightly with Data Acquisition to hunt down missing or low-quality sources, and with the training teams to close the loop on what actually moves loss and downstream evals
- Treat data quality as a systems problem and a research problem. You will write performance-critical code one week and design careful experiments the next

- Build and scale the web crawling systems that discover, schedule, fetch, and parse high-quality documents across the open web for initial training
- Improve URL seeding, scoring, and fair host scheduling so crawl capacity lands on the hosts and pages that matter most for model quality
- Raise crawl success and parsing quality, defeating antibot failures, improving extractors, and capturing content we previously could not get cleanly
- Debug and harden complex crawl infrastructure end-to-end for availability, recovery, and ingestion lag, and automate delivery of crawl datasets into the data pipeline
- Work independently (and alongside AI agents) and partner with Data Quality and Data Platform so new coverage shows up as better tokens in training runs

- Software engineering experience building distributed systems and/or large-scale data infrastructure

- Able to architect and ship end-to-end with high ownership, debug complex systems independently, and work alongside AI agents
- Strong intuitions about large-scale distributed systems
- Excited to learn how pre-training data shapes model quality, and want the ownership and visibility that comes with building systems that feed frontier training runs

Sr. Model Engineer, Safety
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. We train frontier coding agents and scale RL on real user data to make them increasingly effective. We're looking for Research Scientists who can drive effective RL or mid-training research in a small-team setting. You'll own ambiguous, hard research problems end-to-end: forming hypotheses, designing experiments, building the training/eval/data needed to test them, and pushing results into the next model.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Design and run rigorous experiments that turn research ideas into measurable gains in model capability
- Improve data recipes through data quality, deduplication, and mixture experiments
- Define what makes RL data and rewards good, including grader design and preventing reward hacking
- Advance training science, from architecture and scaling experiments to post-training recipes for coding and computer-use agents
- Build evals and targeted tasks that expose model weaknesses and guide where the team invests next
- Partner with engineers to take promising results from small experiments to frontier-scale training runs

- 3+ years of hands-on experience training or post-training large neural networks (1B+ parameters), including work on pre-training, fine-tuning, or RL-based methods (e.g., RLHF, DPO).

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
- Able to handle ambiguous research tasks with little guidance, and to own a research direction end to end
- Care an unusual amount about data quality, and can dive into the data when appropriate
- Truth seeking, aiming to learn more about the science than to prove your ideas are correct
- Experience with RL algorithms for language models, scaling laws, or building RL environments and evals
- Experience with distributed training at scale and debugging problems that only show up at scale
- Experience training frontier-scale models
- Strong background in RL and machine learning fundamentals
- An excellent programmer and software engineer, comfortable working across the research stack in Python and PyTorch or JAX
- Hands-on experience training large models, through pretraining, post-training or RL
